title: What Solar Food Systems Is
definition: Solar Food Systems: food systems powered directly by sun.
description:
Solar Food Systems — Signature Edition: food systems powered directly by sun. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature system hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: solar dryers rethought, system logistics rebuilt, off-grid design reimagined for the century ahead. Nothing here is presented as established fact — it is a designed future, fully specified.

This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the village scale ambition that defines the Signature line.

t: The Signature Vision: Solar Food Systems
title: The Signature Vision: Solar Food Systems
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Solar Food Systems.
description:
The Signature vision of Solar Food Systems does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature system hulls program, charter one: master solar dryers at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale system logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate off-grid design systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Solar Food Systems becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

t: 2030 — First system hulls products reach price parity: solar dryers cul
title: 2030 — First system hulls products reach price parity: solar dryers cul
definition: 2030 milestone on the Solar Food Systems roadmap.
description:
First system hulls products reach price parity: solar dryers cultivation at commercial scale.

What must be true first: the solar dryers results have to replicate outside the lab, system logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and off-grid design operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed solar dryers demonstrations, system logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting off-grid design uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Solar Food Systems
definition: Estimates Solar Food Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Solar Food Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Solar Food Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Solar Food Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Solar Food Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 47503 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where solar dryers monitoring, system logistics redundancy, or off-grid design maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Solar Food Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Solar Food Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Solar Food Systems — food systems powered directly by sun.

Phase 1 — Prove (solar dryers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (off-grid design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (village scale): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and rural-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
